variants.change_description: Fresh control: region window 64, four recognition requests per GPU, static page assignment.

outcome_note.summary: The fresh window-64 control reproduced the earlier p50: 3.80 s versus 3.79 s. All 30 calls passed.
outcome_note.next: The current NACA profile shows queued requests at server concurrency four. Test eight while keeping client concurrency and the region window fixed.

variants.display_name: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 · vLLM + BF16 · Window 64 + dynamic pages
variants.change_description: From window-64 control: assign the next page to the first free layout worker.

outcome_note.summary: Dynamic pages improved p95 to 26.82 s and throughput by 6.3%, but p50 worsened from 3.80 to 3.96 s. All 30 calls passed.
outcome_note.next: Attention OCR became slower; this remains a throughput/tail tradeoff. Compare server concurrency eight with static and dynamic pages.
